result.instructions: Tools for SimplyBook.me, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What bookings do we have for tomorrow, and with which provider?"; "Which services does our company offer, and what are their IDs?"; "Find the client named Anna Kovac and show her last bookings.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SimplyBook.me data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run simplybook_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run simplybook_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run simplybook_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. simplybook_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: simplybook_get_company_info
tools.title: Get company information
tools.description: Get the company profile of the connected SimplyBook.me account. GET /admin/company/info.

tools.name: simplybook_list_categories
tools.title: List service categories
tools.description: List the service categories of the company. GET /admin/categories.

tools.name: simplybook_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the provider locations of the company. GET /admin/locations.

tools.name: simplybook_list_statuses
tools.title: List booking statuses
tools.description: List the booking statuses the company uses. GET /admin/statuses.

tools.name: simplybook_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the services of the company, optionally filtered by text. Use this to find service IDs. GET /admin/services.

tools.name: simplybook_get_service
tools.title: Get a service
tools.description: Fetch one service by ID. GET /admin/services/{id}.

tools.name: simplybook_list_providers
tools.title: List providers
tools.description: List the providers (staff) of the company, optionally for one service. Use this to find provider IDs. GET /admin/providers.

tools.name: simplybook_get_provider
tools.title: Get a provider
tools.description: Fetch one provider by ID. GET /admin/providers/{id}.

tools.name: simplybook_get_available_slots
tools.title: Get available time slots
tools.description: List the free start times of one service with one provider on one day. GET /admin/schedule/available-slots.

count.description: Group booking count, 1 for a single booking.

tools.name: simplybook_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings with optional filters. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. GET /admin/bookings.

date_to.description: Bookings up to this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: simplybook_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Fetch one booking by ID, with its service, provider, client and time. GET /admin/bookings/{id}.

tools.name: simplybook_create_booking
tools.title: Create a booking
tools.description: Book one service with one provider at a start time for an existing or new client. This sends the client a confirmation. POST /admin/bookings.

client_id.description: Existing client ID. Leave out to book without a client record.

location_id.description: Location ID, if the service has locations.

tools.name: simplybook_cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel a booking
tools.description: Cancel one booking by ID. The client may receive a cancellation message. DELETE /admin/bookings/{id}.

tools.name: simplybook_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the clients of the company, optionally filtered by name, email or phone. GET /admin/clients.

tools.name: simplybook_get_client
tools.title: Get a client
tools.description: Fetch one client by ID. GET /admin/clients/{id}.

tools.name: simplybook_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Add a client record with a name and optional email and phone. POST /admin/clients.

tools.name: simplybook_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List orders and invoices, optionally for one client or one date range (YYYY-MM-DD). GET /admin/invoices.

status.description: Invoice status, as the company uses it.

prompts.name: find_open_slots_for_a_service
prompts.title: Find open slots for a service
prompts.description: List the services and providers, then read the available time slots of one provider on one day.

prompts.name: book_a_client_into_a_slot
prompts.title: Book a client into a slot
